command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-noscroll.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SCRIPT="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/validate_matched_eye_ab.py"
BASE="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
STATIC="$TMP/buehne.eye-isolated-noscroll.html"
test -f "$SCRIPT"; test -f "$BASE"
python3 - "$BASE" "$STATIC" "$SCRIPT" <<'PY'
import hashlib,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
base,out,script=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
s=base.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
needle='requestAnimationFrame(schleife);'
n=s.count(needle)
if n != 2: raise SystemExit(f'UNEXPECTED_MAIN_RAF_COUNT={n}')
s=s.replace(needle,'/* GO_EYE_ISOLATION: recursive main rAF suppressed */')
freeze='<style id="go-eye-isolation-freeze">html,body{overflow:hidden!important}::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important;width:0!important;height:0!important}*{animation-play-state:paused!important;transition:none!important}</style>'
if s.count('<head>') != 1: raise SystemExit('UNEXPECTED_HEAD_COUNT')
s=s.replace('<head>','<head>'+freeze,1)
out.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
sha=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p=script.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
p,nsub=re.subn(r'EXPECTED_SHADOW_SHA256 = "[0-9a-f]{64}"',f'EXPECTED_SHADOW_SHA256 = "{sha}"',p,count=1)
if nsub != 1: raise SystemExit('SHADOW_SHA_PATCH_FAIL')
script.write_text(p,encoding='utf-8')
print('BASE_SHADOW_SHA='+hashlib.sha256(base.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('DERIVED_SHADOW_SHA='+sha)
print('MAIN_RAF_REPLACEMENTS='+str(n))
print('CSS_FREEZE=animations+transitions+overflow+scrollbars')
PY
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_isolated_noscroll_ab_20260912"
rm -rf "$OUT"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$SCRIPT" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$STATIC" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9284 --cdp-port 9285 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_isolated_noscroll_ab_20260912.stdout.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
cat "$OUT/report.json"
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_DERIVED_SHADOW_RAF_CSS_SCROLLBAR_FROZEN_CANONICAL_EYE_AB_NO_LIVE_WRITE
